extensionDescription.message: Leggi il web in inglese: parole sconosciute evidenziate, percentuale reale. Offline e senza tracciamento.
extensionDescription.description: The extension's description: the extensions page, and both stores' summary. At most 112 characters (Apple's limit). Names the languages an Italian reader can study in the shipped pairs (English, en-it; French, fr-it, and Spanish, es-it, to come) — not a translation of the French. Tu. « percentuale reale », not « onesta » (with a quantity, onesto reads "reasonable"); « senza tracciamento », not « privato » (which reads "not public").

commandCaptureSelection.message: Acquisisci la selezione (parola o espressione) insieme alla frase
commandCaptureSelection.description: The Alt+L command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: capture the selected word or phrase together with its sentence. Imperative, as the browsers' Italian pages word their commands; contains the words the Italian settings give it (« acquisisci la selezione »).

commandToggleDrawer.message: Apri o chiudi il pannello di ripasso sulla pagina
commandToggleDrawer.description: The Alt+Shift+D command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open or close the in-page review panel (the drawer). Contains the words the Italian settings give it (« pannello di ripasso sulla pagina »).

commandSidePanel.message: Apri il riquadro laterale di ripasso
commandSidePanel.description: The Alt+Shift+S command, as the browser's shortcuts page describes it: open the browser's review side panel (Chromium). Contains the words the Italian settings give it (« riquadro laterale », Chrome's Italian word for its side panel, which keeps « pannello » for Lingua's own panels).
